description: This script tests Git's skip-worktree bit functionality, including setting, removing, and verifying the status of files with this bit, as well as their behavior during common Git operations.

methods.name: setup_absent
methods.description: Removes file '1' if it exists, then sets its index to skip-worktree.

methods.name: test_absent
methods.description: Verifies that file '1' is absent from the index and filesystem after removal.

methods.name: setup_dirty
methods.description: Creates file '1' with 'dirty' content, adds it to index, and sets skip-worktree bit.

methods.name: test_dirty
methods.description: Checks that file '1' remains tracked with 'dirty' content and skip-worktree bit set.
